module: "Camera distance" debug UI app. Every frame, measures the distance between the player vehicle and the camera, pushes it to the UI via guihooks.trigger('cameraDistance', distance) and draws in the world a red sphere of radius 0.5 m on the vehicle with the label "camera distance target".
notes: Without a player vehicle, sends cameraDistance(-1, "no vehicle") and draws nothing.
Distance in meters. A TODO in the code plans to replace the guihooks.trigger with a stream.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: draws the sphere and the debug text on the player vehicle and sends the vehicle-camera distance to the UI.
